name: my-taste
description: A local-first contextual preference layer that deeply captures and applies evidence-backed writing, UI, website, screenshot, and video taste.

interface.shortDescription: Deeply capture and apply your creative preferences.
interface.longDescription: Forensically capture style references from writing, websites, screenshots, and video, including deterministic pixel evidence when available, then retrieve the right preferences automatically for future creative tasks.
defaultPrompt: I like this website screenshot. Deeply analyze its geometry, typography, palette, component grammar, and pixel evidence, then save it to My Taste.
Use my saved UI taste when creating this landing page.
I like how this Reel is edited. Save its video style.
